A_additive_consult_proposition.law: doc 06 §2a: a sanctioned secret is 'never sent to any engine or provider' — absolute
A_additive_consult_proposition.was: AdditiveEngineCheck.propositionFor embeds action.target.label verbatim; the loop sent it to engine.judge (the cloud Jev primary in prod). Reachable only post-injection (cardSecrets non-empty) + classify null + mutationNet SUSPICIOUS (TAP/SUBMIT) — narrow, but the law is absolute.
A_additive_consult_proposition.now: NavigationLoop masks the consult proposition with the same redactedLabel/cardSecrets seam the decide question uses, BEFORE the engine sees it; the masking is loud on the step log ('additive consult proposition carried a sanctioned secret - masked ([credential-redacted]) before the engine'). CHOSEN OVER SKIPPING deliberately: skipping the consult would fail the additive H9 net OPEN (no engine answer = no H9 added); masking keeps the §3 check functional while honoring the law. Deterministic: same fold, same marker.

B_execute_step_log_line.was: NavigationLoop's execute line interpolated candidate.label raw — clean only via the finish() boundary scrub, so the value transited the in-memory stepLog.
B_execute_step_log_line.now: The line is built by one companion builder, NavigationLoop.executeLine(kind, label, cx, cy, dispatched, typedMarker, redact), which redactedLabel-masks the label at SOURCE; the loop is its only caller. The finish() scrub stays as the report boundary's second layer (defense in depth). Non-credential tasks (empty redact) keep the line byte-identical.

C_serializer_cap_prefix.was: The enumerator truncates candidate labels at the serializer's 40-char cap (CandidateEnumerator.MAX_LABEL_LENGTH = TreeSerializer.MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 40) BEFORE any masking sees them — a sanctioned secret longer than the cap leaked its capped prefix raw into state text / question payloads / history.
C_serializer_cap_prefix.now: The loop derives ONE redaction key set — every sanctioned secret PLUS the take(40) prefix of any longer one (loop-local redactionKeys(), deterministic, full secret folded first so the prefix pass only fires where truncation actually cut the value) — and passes it to every masking seam: the state builder's secrets param, actionQuestion/shadowQuestion, the HISTORY digest, the execute line, the consult proposition, and the finish() scrub. Consequence (accepted, fail-closed): the builder's app-authored-section LOUD check now also fires on a capped prefix — a secret FRAGMENT in an app-authored section is a doc 05 §2 violation, so loud is the lawful render; the only realistic app-authored carrier remains the tracker-progress/hint path already disclosed as fail-closed in the verifier's (D) (action-multi x credential-echo overlap, out of this dispatch's scope).
